scenarios.text: A raider mortar shell lands one cell west of a colonist standing behind a sandbag line in a killbox. The colonist arcs about three cells east, sails clean over the sandbags, and lands alive, staggered and stunned for a moment.
scenarios.expect: accept: a mortar beside a person throws them about three cells over sandbags, alive and briefly stunned.

scenarios.text: A mortar shell hits one cell from a colonist; two cells east of them is a wooden barricade line. The colonist lifts off but drops at the foot of the barricade, two cells short of where the same shell throws a colonist in an open lane.
scenarios.expect: reject: the throw must carry over sandbags and barricades, not stop at them.

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist on open dirt; she flies three cells and the landing itself kills her, though the shell's own blast left her only lightly hurt.
scenarios.expect: reject: the thrown colonist must land alive and briefly stunned, not die of the throw.

scenarios.text: A colonist hauling steel is caught one cell from a mortar hit; she is carried through the air along a visible arc, and while she is airborne a second colonist walks onto her landing cell, yet she still comes down on exactly that cell.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown pawn lands on the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted.

scenarios.text: A grenade lands beside a colonist; he vanishes from his cell and is instantly standing three cells away, with no flight between.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn must be carried through the air, not teleported to the landing cell.

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown three cells by a mortar and lands; the stun icon clears after a few seconds, but she stands idle for the rest of the day and never picks her hauling job back up.
scenarios.expect: reject: the pawn must go back to work when the stun ends.

scenarios.text: A thrown colonist is in the air when a cat wanders onto his planned landing cell; mid-flight his arc bends and he lands on the next cell over instead.
scenarios.expect: reject: the flyer must never re-target to another cell when the landing cell is taken.

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off one cell from a colonist asleep in his bed and a colonist carrying a downed friend to the hospital; the sleeper stays in bed and the carrier stays on his cell with the friend still in his arms, while a plain colonist at the same distance is thrown.
scenarios.expect: accept: pawns in bed and pawns carrying a pawn are never thrown.

scenarios.text: A grenade lands one cell from a colonist resting in a hospital bed after surgery; the blast throws her out of the bed three cells across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn in bed is never thrown.

scenarios.text: A grenade drops into a pit where a colonist and a stack of steel already lie on the pit floor; the blast throws both up and out onto the rim.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn already in a pit and goods already on a pit floor are never thrown.

scenarios.text: A frag grenade's edge just reaches a wood stack at the far rim of its radius, where the computed throw is under one cell; the stack stays where it was while stacks nearer the blast fly.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thing at the rim whose throw is under one cell is spared.

scenarios.text: With default settings, a grenade goes off one cell from an 80 kg raider corpse and a 60 kg colonist corpse; the 60 kg corpse flies and the 80 kg one stays where it lay.
scenarios.expect: accept: corpses over the 75 kg goods mass limit are spared, lighter ones are thrown.

scenarios.text: The player sets the creature mass limit to 20 kg in Mod Settings; a grenade then lands beside a 60 kg human corpse and the corpse stays put, as if the creature limit weighed it.
scenarios.expect: reject: the creature mass limit weighs living pawns only, so a corpse under 75 kg is still thrown.

scenarios.text: A rhino of about 180 kg and a muffalo of about 144 kg stand one cell from a mortar impact at default settings; the muffalo is thrown and the rhino does not move.
scenarios.expect: accept: the 150 kg creature mass limit spares the rhino while the muffalo under it flies.

scenarios.text: One mortar shell lands among a rat, a colonist, a muffalo and a thrumbo, each one cell away; the rat lands about five cells out, the colonist three, the muffalo two, and the thrumbo does not move.
scenarios.expect: accept: lighter creatures fly farther and a thrumbo over 150 kg is not thrown at all.

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands one cell from a rat, a colonist and a muffalo spaced around it; all three fly exactly three cells and land in a neat ring.
scenarios.expect: reject: heavier creatures must fly less, not every creature thrown alike.

scenarios.text: A modded heavy shell deals 100 Bomb damage with the vanilla mortar's 2.9 radius; a colonist one cell away lands about five cells out, where the vanilla 50-damage mortar throws the same colonist three.
scenarios.expect: accept: force scales with this blast's damage over the type's normal damage, so twice the damage throws farther.

scenarios.text: A modded shell with twice the mortar's Bomb damage and the same radius hits beside a colonist and a muffalo; each lands on exactly the cell the ordinary mortar shell gives them.
scenarios.expect: reject: a bigger blast must throw farther when blast power from damage is on, the default.

scenarios.text: A thrumbo grazing one cell from a mortar impact is hurled two cells across the field at default settings.
scenarios.expect: reject: a creature heavier than the 150 kg creature mass limit is not thrown at all.

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown by a grenade, and a second grenade lands beside her one second after she lands, while she is still stunned; she takes the blast damage but is not thrown again.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn just thrown is spared a second throw until its stun and a short recovery end.

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown by a grenade; the player saves and reloads at once, and a second grenade lands beside her during her stun; she is thrown again.
scenarios.expect: reject: the recovery immunity must hold across a save and reload.

scenarios.text: Two raiders lob grenades in quick succession at the same colonist; he is batted back and forth between the blasts three times in four seconds.
scenarios.expect: reject: a just-thrown pawn must not be juggled by back-to-back blasts.

scenarios.text: A colonist thrown by a grenade has recovered from the stun and the short recovery has passed; a third grenade lands beside him and throws him again.
scenarios.expect: accept: after the window ends a pawn can be thrown again; the immunity is not permanent.

scenarios.text: A colonist dragging a FlowWorks hose end across the yard is thrown three cells by a grenade; the hose end stays on the cell she was standing on, still connected.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown hose carrier drops the hose end where they stood.

scenarios.text: A colonist carrying a hose end is thrown by a mortar and lands three cells away still holding the hose end, the hose stretched after her.
scenarios.expect: reject: the hose end must drop on the takeoff cell, not fly with the carrier.

scenarios.text: A colonist stands two cells from a granite wall with a grenade going off on the far side of him; he is thrown into the wall, stops dead on the cell before it and takes a bruise from the impact.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and takes an impact hit.

scenarios.text: A colonist thrown toward a steel wall stops on the cell before it, then eases half a cell back off the wall before settling.
scenarios.expect: reject: people never rebound, not even half a step back.

scenarios.text: A colonist thrown into a stone wall bounces off it like a crate and tumbles back two cells toward the blast.
scenarios.expect: reject: thrown people stop dead at walls and never rebound like goods.

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown into a wall and stops on the cell before it, but her health tab shows no new injury from hitting it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stopped by a wall takes an impact hit.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a colonist toward a raider standing two cells beyond him; he stops on the cell before the raider and both show a fresh impact bruise.
scenarios.expect: accept: a thrown person stops at a pawn in the way and takes an impact hit, as at a wall.

scenarios.text: A thrown colonist's arc passes straight over a standing raider two cells away and she lands three cells out behind him.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person must stop at another pawn in the way, not pass through.

scenarios.text: A colonist thrown into a standing colonist stops on the cell before him, but neither shows any injury from the collision.
scenarios.expect: reject: the stopped pawn takes an impact hit, as at a wall.

scenarios.text: A colonist two cells from a closed wooden door is thrown toward it by a grenade; he stops on the cell before the door, takes an impact hit, and the door loses hit points.
scenarios.expect: accept: a closed door stops a throw and takes damage.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a colonist toward a closed autodoor three cells away; she flies through it as if it were open and lands in the room beyond.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed door stops a throw.

scenarios.text: A mortar on a riverbank throws a colonist toward the deep channel and he lands in the deep water two cells out.
scenarios.expect: reject: deep water stops a throw on the last cell a pawn can stand on.

scenarios.text: A colonist on a lakeshore two cells from deep water is thrown toward it by a grenade; she comes down on the last shallow cell before the deep water.
scenarios.expect: accept: deep water stops a throw on the last standable cell.

scenarios.text: A colonist wearing a charged shield belt stands beside a frag grenade; the belt flashes and absorbs the blast, he stays on his cell, and the belt's charge drops more than an ordinary absorb would take.
scenarios.expect: accept: a belt that absorbs the blast keeps its wearer in place and pays extra charge.

scenarios.text: A belted colonist beside a grenade sees the belt absorb the blast, yet she is still thrown three cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: a shield belt that absorbs the blast keeps its wearer in place.

scenarios.text: A belted colonist stays put when a grenade goes off beside him, and the belt loses exactly the charge it would have lost to that blast with no knockback mod.
scenarios.expect: reject: the belt must pay extra charge for holding its wearer.

scenarios.text: A belted colonist stands inside a cloud of the Cauldron's vent gas when a fire reaches it; a clump bursts beside her and she is shoved one cell, unhurt, though her belt is charged.
scenarios.expect: accept: a burning gas clump's one-cell shove is the exception a belt does not stop.

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in a stockpile beside a wall; steel, components and a corpse fly up in high arcs, spinning fast, hit the wall and bounce back a shorter way, each bounce shorter than the last, until they come to rest.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods fly wild with arc, spin and rebounds that lose energy until spent.

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a stockpile; the stacks slide along the ground in straight lines, never leaving the floor or turning, and stop where they land.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods must fly in a high arc and spin fast, not slide.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a stack of wood toward a wall two cells away; it hits the wall and drops dead at its foot although its throw had four cells left.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods rebound off walls, carrying on part of the throw still left, not stopping at the first wall.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a stack of rice toward a closed door; it bounces off and rebounds the full four cells it still had left, then again off the opposite wall just as far.
scenarios.expect: reject: each rebound carries on for only part of the way the throw still had left, so bounces die away.

scenarios.text: A grenade kills a raider standing in the middle of the colony's food stockpile; his corpse is flung through the air in a spinning arc along with the food.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn the blast kills is thrown as a corpse among the goods.

scenarios.text: A mortar near a river throws a stack of silver toward deep water; it sails into the deep channel and is gone.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods are never thrown into deep water.

scenarios.text: A light stack of herbal medicine lies beside a colonist, both one cell from a mortar hit, with a sandbag line beyond; the colonist lands three cells out and the medicine sails over the sandbags to land about five cells out.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods fly about 1.6 times as far as a person, over sandbags.

scenarios.text: A raider bomb goes off in the middle of a packed 12x12 stockpile, one light stack per cell, more than 60 stacks within reach; every stack it reaches with a throw of a cell or more flies, along with the three colonists working there.
scenarios.expect: accept: every light good the blast reaches moves, however many; the 40-throw cap is gone.

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a dense stockpile; about forty stacks fly, and the rest within the same distance of the impact sit still on their cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: the 40-throw cap is removed; nothing is skipped over a cap.

scenarios.text: In a big stockpile blast the stacks nearest the impact fly in arcs, while the stacks farther out vanish and reappear a few cells away in the same tick.
scenarios.expect: reject: every good moves by flight; far stacks must not hop instantly while near ones fly.

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off in a storeroom beside a shelf of medicine, a hopper of corn and a dining table set with meals; all the goods fly off and the shelf, hopper and table are left empty.
scenarios.expect: accept: open shelves, hoppers and tables protect nothing.

scenarios.text: A mortar lands two cells from a row of ordinary shelves in the storeroom; the loose floor stacks scatter, but every item on the shelves stays exactly where it was.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods on open shelves scatter like floor goods; there is no exemption for shelves.

scenarios.text: A grenade lands beside a modded fridge that shows its meals stacked inside; the fridge is treated as closed and every meal stays put.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything that draws its contents is open, period.

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off one cell from a Deep Storage weapons locker full of rifles, with an empty cell behind it; the locker slides a cell or so away from the blast and every rifle is still inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: a closed 1x1 container under 250 kg keeps its goods and is shoved a short way when the cell behind is free.

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a Deep Storage weapons locker; the locker bursts open and its rifles scatter across the floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: closed containers keep their goods.

scenarios.text: A weapons locker stands with an open pit directly behind it; a grenade goes off on its far side and shoves the locker into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container is never shoved into a pit; with no free cell behind it, it jolts in place.

scenarios.text: A weapons locker sits against a wall when a grenade goes off on its open side; it stays on its cell with a brief visible jolt, its contents unchanged.
scenarios.expect: accept: a container without a free cell behind it jolts in place.

scenarios.text: A 2x2 ancient security crate sits in a raided storeroom with clear floor behind it; a grenade beside it pushes the whole crate a cell across the room.
scenarios.expect: reject: only a 1x1 closed container may be thrown; a larger one jolts.

scenarios.text: A weapons locker loaded to about 180 kg with weapons inside, empty floor behind it, only jolts in place when a grenade goes off beside it, as if it were over a weight limit.
scenarios.expect: reject: the container limit is 250 kg, not the 75 kg goods limit, so a 180 kg locker with a free cell behind is thrown a short way.

scenarios.text: A Deep Storage safe weighing 500 kg stands beside a grenade blast with clear floor behind it; it jolts in place and its silver stays inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: a container over the 250 kg container mass limit jolts rather than being thrown, goods kept.

scenarios.text: One of the Armoury's secret floor panels, carrying the opt-in tag, holds a stash of weapons beside a grenade blast; the weapons stay hidden inside the panel.
scenarios.expect: accept: another mod's hiding container given the opt-in tag counts as closed and keeps its goods.

scenarios.text: A mortar throws a 40 kg stack of steel into a colonist two cells away; the colonist takes a 3-point blunt bruise and staggers for about half a second, and the steel stops at his feet.
scenarios.expect: accept: a heavy stack gives a light knock and a stagger, then stops.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a stack of cloth weighing about 2 kg along a ray through a colonist; the cloth bruises her for 3 blunt damage as it passes.
scenarios.expect: reject: light goods pass without hurting anyone; only heavy stacks knock.

scenarios.text: A 40 kg stack of steel thrown by a mortar flies straight through a colonist in its path, bruising him, and carries on three more cells past him.
scenarios.expect: reject: a heavy stack stops at the pawn it strikes.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a small 2 kg stack of herbal medicine at a colonist; it flies past her and she takes no damage.
scenarios.expect: accept: light goods pass a pawn untouched.

scenarios.text: Two colonists stand one cell from blasts in two separate lanes, one a frag grenade and the other an incendiary shell; the incendiary colonist is thrown roughly half as far as the frag-grenade colonist.
scenarios.expect: accept: bombs throw at full strength and fire at about half.

scenarios.text: An incendiary mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist at default settings; she catches fire but is not moved at all.
scenarios.expect: reject: fire and incendiary blasts throw at about half strength by default.

scenarios.text: An EMP grenade and a smoke grenade each burst one cell from a colonist; neither colonist moves.
scenarios.expect: accept: harmless bursts throw nothing.

scenarios.text: A toxic gas burst goes off beside a colonist and pushes him two cells back.
scenarios.expect: reject: toxic gas bursts throw at 0 percent; harmless bursts throw nothing.

scenarios.text: Outer Rim's sonic grenade, a damaging explosion from another mod our patch does not tune, goes off beside a colonist and throws her at full strength, the journal reading 100 percent.
scenarios.expect: accept: other mods' damaging explosions throw too, at 100 percent by default.

scenarios.text: The other-mods percent is set to 50; a modded incendiary blast whose damage type is the fire type our patch already tunes throws a colonist only about a quarter as far as a frag grenade.
scenarios.expect: reject: the other-mods percent applies only to untuned damage types and is never stacked on fire's half.

scenarios.text: A modded super-bomb whose damage type inherits from Bomb (BombSuper) goes off beside a colonist and throws her at full Bomb strength.
scenarios.expect: accept: a damage type inheriting from Bomb throws, like every harmful explosion.

scenarios.text: A tribal raider strikes a colonist with a mace and the colonist is shoved back one cell by the blow.
scenarios.expect: reject: only explosions throw; the melee shove belongs to FlowWorks, not this mod.

scenarios.text: A sniper's rifle bullet hits a colonist in the shoulder and the impact knocks him back two cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: bullets move nobody; only explosions throw.

scenarios.text: A colonist is punched in melee and then shot by a rifle, staying on his cell both times; a grenade then lands beside him and throws him.
scenarios.expect: accept: only explosions throw; melee and bullets move nobody.

scenarios.text: A modder's grenade projectile carries a knockback force of zero while its Bomb damage type normally throws; it goes off beside a colonist and the colonist is not moved.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon's own zero turns the throw off, and the projectile's setting wins over the damage type.

scenarios.text: A projectile's knockback setting is zero, but the blast still throws the colonist three cells because its Bomb damage type has a throw.
scenarios.expect: reject: the projectile's setting comes first, and zero turns the throw off.

scenarios.text: A grav-ram, whose own creature mass limit is 216 kg, fires at a 190 kg animal and throws it, while a frag grenade beside the same animal leaves it in place.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon's own creature mass limit lets it throw pawns heavier than the 150 kg global limit.

scenarios.text: A weapon with an impact factor of 0 throws a colonist into a wall, a second into a standing pawn and a third into a closed door; all three stop, nobody is hurt by the impact and the door's hit points are unchanged.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes its throws hit walls, pawns and doors harmlessly.

scenarios.text: A launcher with an own maximum throw of 4 cells and a per-weapon cap scale of 0.5 throws a rat a full 4 cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: the per-weapon cap scale shortens the own maximum, so the throw is capped at 2.

scenarios.text: A cloud of the Cauldron's vent gas hangs over a stockpile and a fire touches its edge; it goes off in small bursts one clump after another as the fire front runs through, each burst tossing the goods near it, and a colonist inside is shoved one cell, unhurt.
scenarios.expect: accept: a lit gas cloud goes off clump by clump, scattering goods and shoving people one cell unhurt.

scenarios.text: A fire touches a 40-cell cloud of the Cauldron's vent gas and the whole cloud detonates at once as one big blast at its centre, throwing everything around it.
scenarios.expect: reject: gas goes off clump by clump, never one centroid blast.

scenarios.text: A colonist stands in a burning gas cloud as it goes off clump by clump; each burst beside him leaves a burn or bruise on his health tab.
scenarios.expect: reject: the gas clump shove moves a person one cell with no damage.

scenarios.text: A colonist in a burning gas cloud is shoved one cell by a clump burst, then shoved again by the next clump half a second later, and again.
scenarios.expect: reject: a person is shoved at most once every 2 seconds.

scenarios.text: Goods lie on clear floor just outside a burning gas cloud, a cell from its edge; as the edge clump bursts they are tossed a cell or two, while goods five cells away stay put.
scenarios.expect: accept: each clump scatters goods within its own small radius, including just outside the cloud.

scenarios.text: A torch lamp stands three cells from a drifting cloud of the Cauldron's vent gas, not touching it; the cloud starts going off clump by clump anyway.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas cloud catches only from a fire touching it.

scenarios.text: The Cauldron vents its gas into a workshop with loose goods on the floor; a dropped torch sets fire to the cloud's edge and it goes off clump by clump, scattering the goods.
scenarios.expect: accept: the Cauldron's gas burns clump by clump.

scenarios.text: With the gas chain switched on, the Cauldron's vent gas touched by a fire simply burns as a sheet of flame with no bursts and no goods moved.
scenarios.expect: reject: the Cauldron's gas must go off clump by clump, not burn as plain fire.

scenarios.text: A second gas source of ours, which the census has tagged as flammable, releases its cloud over loose goods; a fire touches its edge and it burns as a plain sheet of flame, with no clump bursts and no goods moved.
scenarios.expect: reject: every gas source of ours the census tags as flammable goes off clump by clump, not only the Cauldron's.

scenarios.text: A raider stands on a covered pit trap and a grenade lands two cells from it, the cover inside its radius; the cover breaks and the raider falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: a damaging blast reaching a cover within its radius breaks it, and whoever is on it falls.

scenarios.text: A grenade lands two cells from a covered pit with a raider on it, the cover inside the blast radius; the cover stays whole because the grenade did not land on it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a blast that reaches the cover within its radius breaks it, not only one centred on it.

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell lands on a covered pit with a raider standing on it; the cover breaks and the raider drops in.
scenarios.expect: accept: a fire blast breaks a pit cover too.

scenarios.text: A smoke grenade bursts on top of a covered pit trap where a raider is standing; the cover cracks apart and the raider falls through.
scenarios.expect: reject: an EMP, smoke or stun burst never breaks a pit cover.

scenarios.text: A gas clump bursts beside a raider and shoves him one cell onto a covered pit; the cover gives way and he falls in.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn a gas burst shoves onto a cover stands on it, the cover whole.

scenarios.text: A grenade on the near side of a 1-wide open pit throws a colonist across it; he lands on the far rim, untouched by the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor; nothing is thrown across.

scenarios.text: A mortar throws a raider and a stack of steel toward an open pit; both drop to its floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a colonist onto a covered pit cell; she crashes through the cover and lands on the pit floor, the cover broken.
scenarios.expect: accept: a throw onto a covered cell falls through and breaks the cover.

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a stack of wood onto a covered pit cell; the stack comes to rest on top of the cover and the cover stays intact.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thing thrown onto a cover falls through and breaks it.

scenarios.text: A gas clump burst shoves a colonist one cell, onto the edge cell of an open pit; she falls in, with no blast injury.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump's one-cell shove onto an open pit cell drops the pawn in.

scenarios.text: A raider bomb goes off in the colony storeroom while two haulers work beside the open pit at its edge; several stacks and one hauler are thrown into the pit and land on its floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: his flagship scene: items and people fall into the pit beside a bombed storeroom.

scenarios.text: After a blast throws a stack of components and a raider corpse into a pit with a lowered ladder, a hauler climbs down the ladder, picks them up, and carries them back to the stockpile and the grave.
scenarios.expect: accept: a colonist can fetch thrown goods and corpses back off a pit floor.

scenarios.text: A blast throws a stack of silver onto a pit floor that has a lowered ladder; with hauling queued for a whole day, no colonist will touch it and it shows as unreachable.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods thrown into a pit stay retrievable.

scenarios.text: To fetch a corpse a blast threw into a pit, a hauler walks straight off the rim and drops in, ignoring the lowered ladder.
scenarios.expect: reject: fetching uses the ladder; a colonist enters a pit only by force, never by ordinary pathing.

scenarios.text: A mortar lands in a stockpile; a puff of dust rises over each stack, the stacks vanish, and a moment later they appear several cells away.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff.

scenarios.text: Throughout a mortar strike and a burning gas chain, every scattered stack is visible every frame of its journey, rising, spinning and coming down, and none blinks out and in.
scenarios.expect: accept: goods travel visibly and never vanish and reappear.

scenarios.text: In a big blast the first forty stacks fly properly, but the stacks after them blink out and reappear on new cells with a dust puff.
scenarios.expect: reject: the hop must not survive as an overflow path.

scenarios.text: A colonist is ordered to a cell on the far side of an open pit and another to a cell across a covered pit; both walk around the pits and neither falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing.

scenarios.text: A colonist ordered to haul across the yard takes the straight route over a covered pit trap and falls through it.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into an open or covered pit by ordinary pathing.

scenarios.text: A raider charging the base walks over a covered pit trap that is hidden from him; the cover gives and he falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: an enemy may walk into a pit hidden from it.

scenarios.text: The player opens the Explosive Knockback Mod Settings page and finds a slider labelled 'Maximum throws per explosion: 40'.
scenarios.expect: reject: the removed cap settings must be gone from the page.

scenarios.text: The player turns 'goods in the air' off; a mortar into a stockpile then throws the colonists as usual, while every loose stack stays on its cell.
scenarios.expect: accept: with goods in the air off, goods are unthrown and the rest still works.

scenarios.text: With 'goods in the air' switched off, a mortar into a stockpile makes the stacks pop to new cells under a dust puff.
scenarios.expect: reject: the off state is goods unthrown, never the old hop.

scenarios.text: With the closed-container guard switched off, a grenade beside a weapons locker throws its rifles out across the floor like loose goods.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed guard off means container goods are thrown loose.

scenarios.text: With 'Sealed crates count as closed containers' turned off, a grenade beside a 1x1 sealed crate with a free cell behind it makes the crate jolt in place.
scenarios.expect: reject: with that switch off a sealed crate is neither thrown nor jolted.

scenarios.text: With 'fire at half' switched off, an incendiary shell beside a colonist sets her alight but moves her not at all, while a frag grenade still throws a colonist in the next lane.
scenarios.expect: accept: fire at half off means fire throws nothing, the rest still working.

scenarios.text: With 'blast power from damage' switched off, a modded shell with twice the mortar's damage and the mortar's radius throws a colonist exactly three cells, the same as an ordinary mortar shell.
scenarios.expect: accept: with blast power from damage off, a throw ignores the blast's damage.

scenarios.text: The player switches the gas chain off, and afterwards frag grenades stop throwing colonists too.
scenarios.expect: reject: each part switches off cleanly with the rest still working.

scenarios.text: With the heavy knock switched off, a 40 kg steel stack thrown at a colonist flies past him and he takes no damage.
scenarios.expect: accept: heavy knock off means stacks pass people.

scenarios.text: With the container shove switched off, a grenade beside a weapons locker with a free cell behind it leaves the locker on its cell, rifles still inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: container shove off means containers stay, goods kept.

scenarios.text: On Archmagi with the full mod list, a 6-shell barrage into a full 10x10 stockpile and a 40-cell gas chain at normal speed log a 99th-percentile frame of 38 ms in the measured window, with one random 140 ms stall reported beside it.
scenarios.expect: accept: the bar is the 99th-percentile frame at most 50 ms; a single random stall is reported, not judged.

scenarios.text: The barrage and gas chain on the full list average 22 ms per frame, but the 99th-percentile frame inside the window is 71 ms, a visible stutter through the bursts.
scenarios.expect: reject: the 99th-percentile frame must be at most 50 ms; an average is not the bar.

scenarios.text: The barrage test reads a 99th-percentile frame of 30 ms, but the probe stopped logging at 4 seconds, before the gas chain finished burning through.
scenarios.expect: reject: the measure must cover the barrage and the gas chain inside the window.

scenarios.text: A tester starts the frame probe, fires one grenade into a stack of goods and stops it; the log holds one row per rendered frame, each with its frame time and the count of things in the air, and a deliberate 100 ms sleep appears as a 100 ms row.
scenarios.expect: accept: the probe records every frame's time while goods are in the air.

scenarios.text: The frame probe writes one line per second with the average frame time, and a 200 ms hitch during a grenade's scatter does not appear in its log.
scenarios.expect: reject: the probe must record every frame, not sample once a second.

scenarios.text: The probe logs one row per game tick of the scatter, and a frame rendered while the game is paused leaves no row.
scenarios.expect: reject: the probe must record frames, not ticks.

scenarios.text: On the full list, a mortar raid hits a stocked storeroom of open shelves and closed lockers, and a scripted grenade breaks the covered pit trap; the player saves while a steel stack is mid-air, reloads, and the stack lands once, nothing duplicated or lost.
scenarios.expect: accept: the walk's raid, with a mid-way reload, keeps every thing in the air.

scenarios.text: In the full-list raid walk, a save while three stacks are in the air and an immediate reload leaves one of the stacks gone and another on the floor twice.
scenarios.expect: reject: a reload must neither lose nor duplicate a thing in the air.

scenarios.text: The walk's frame row is marked PASS from the mod-on arm alone, because no mod-off arm was run on the same colony.
scenarios.expect: reject: the frame row is UNMEASURED, never a pass, unless both the mod-on and mod-off arms are measured.

scenarios.text: The raid walk is repeated in the second order, gas first and then mortars; this time the journal shows a pile of stacks the blasts reached with neither a throw request nor a logged skip.
scenarios.expect: reject: in each order every thing reached has a request or a logged skip, matching the kernel's plan.

scenarios.text: A raider's mortar shell lands one cell west of a colonist who is crouched behind a sandbag line two cells to her east. She arcs through the air toward the sandbags, lands alive and briefly stunned on the cell just in front of them, and the sandbags absorb the rest of the throw.
scenarios.expect: reject: the mortar throw must carry her about three cells clean over the sandbag line, not stop in front of it.

scenarios.text: A hauling colonist is thrown by a mortar shell. While he is in the air, a second colonist walks onto the cell he is heading for, so his arc bends slightly and he lands on the free cell beside it, stunned, and then he goes back to hauling.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn lands on the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted mid-flight.

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands among a tame muffalo herd and kills one muffalo outright. The living muffalo beside it are thrown about two cells, and the dead muffalo's corpse spins away in a high arc with them, just like the human corpses in the same blast.
scenarios.expect: reject: a muffalo corpse weighs about 144 kg, over the 75 kg goods mass limit, so a corpse that heavy is never thrown, even when the blast killed it.

scenarios.text: A player sets the creature mass limit in Mod Settings to 20 kg. A grenade then goes off between a living colonist and a colonist's corpse at the same distance; the living colonist stays where she stands, and the 60 kg corpse is thrown across the room.
scenarios.expect: accept: the creature limit weighs living pawns only, and a corpse is weighed only by the 75 kg goods limit, so the corpse is thrown.

scenarios.text: A grav-ram strike hits beside a 200 kg wild animal and throws it a short way across the field, even though the creature mass limit in Mod Settings is still 150 kg.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon with its own creature mass limit (the grav-ram's 216 kg) throws pawns under that limit instead of the global 150 kg one.

scenarios.text: A modded heavy bomb of the Bomb damage type deals 100 damage, twice a mortar shell's 50, at the same radius. It goes off one cell from a colonist and throws him exactly three cells, the same as a mortar shell did to his neighbour a moment earlier.
scenarios.expect: reject: at twice the damage the force doubles, so the colonist must fly farther than the mortar's three cells; a bigger blast that throws no farther fails.

scenarios.text: A colonist is thrown two cells toward a granite wall by a grenade. She lands on the cell before the wall, takes a bruise from the impact, then slides back half a step from the wall before she gets up.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at the wall and never rebounds or eases back, not even half a step.

scenarios.text: A weapon whose tuning sets its impact factor to 0 throws a colonist toward a closed wooden door. He stops on the cell in front of the door with no new injury, and the door's hit points do not change.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes throws hit walls, pawns and doors harmlessly, and the door is undamaged.

scenarios.text: A belted colonist stands in a pocket of the Cauldron's vent gas when a fire lights it; a nearby clump bursts and shoves her one cell sideways, unhurt, while her shield belt flickers but does not hold her in place.
scenarios.expect: accept: a burning gas clump's one-cell shove is the stated exception, and a shield belt does not stop it.

scenarios.text: A mortar shell scatters a stockpile of medicine and components in a storeroom. The stacks spin in high arcs; those heading for the closed wooden door hit it and drop flat at its foot, while the stacks thrown at the stone wall beside it bounce back and roll out.
scenarios.expect: reject: thrown goods rebound off closed doors as well as walls; stopping dead at the door is a broken rebound.

scenarios.text: A grenade lands between a colonist and a stack of silver, each one cell from the impact. The colonist and the silver both arc through the air and land about three cells out, side by side.
scenarios.expect: reject: loose goods fly wild, about 1.6 times as far as a person at the same distance, so the silver should land well past the colonist.

scenarios.text: A raider's high-explosive charge goes off in the middle of a packed 12x12 stockpile. Most stacks fly, but a few dozen stacks near the edge of the blast, well inside its radius, sit still, and the dev log shows a line about a per-explosion throw cap being reached.
scenarios.expect: reject: every light loose good the blast reaches with a throw of a cell or more moves; the 40-throw cap is removed and nothing is skipped over a cap.

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in a kitchen beside a modded refrigerator that shows the meals stacked on its shelves. The loose meals on the floor fly, but the meals shown in the refrigerator stay on it, untouched, because it is a refrigerator.
scenarios.expect: reject: anything that draws its contents is open, period, so a refrigerator that shows its meals scatters them like floor goods.

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a Deep Storage weapons locker loaded with rifles until it weighs 140 kg, with a free cell behind it. The locker keeps all its rifles inside and only jolts in place, because it is over the 75 kg limit.
scenarios.expect: reject: containers use the 250 kg container mass limit, not the 75 kg goods limit, so a 140 kg locker with a free cell behind it is thrown a short way.

scenarios.text: A weapons locker stands with an open pit directly behind it. A grenade lands on the other side and the locker tips back into the pit, still closed with every weapon inside, so a colonist can climb down and recover it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a closed container is never shoved into a pit, even with its goods kept; it must jolt in place instead.

scenarios.text: The player switches 'Sealed crates count as closed containers' off. A mortar shell then lands beside a 1x1 sealed crate with a free cell behind it; the crate does not move or jolt, and its goods stay sealed inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: a sealed crate keeps its goods in its own holder whatever the switch says, and with the switch off it is neither thrown nor jolted.

scenarios.text: The player turns the container shove off in Mod Settings. In the next raid a grenade lands beside a row of weapons lockers; the lockers stay put, but their weapons spill out and fly across the armoury like loose goods.
scenarios.expect: reject: with the container shove off, closed containers stay put and keep their goods; only switching the closed guard off throws their goods loose.

scenarios.text: A mortar flings a 75-unit stack of steel at a colonist two cells away. It hits him for a 3-point bruise, he staggers for half a second, and the steel carries on past him to land a cell behind him.
scenarios.expect: reject: a heavy stack that strikes a pawn knocks and staggers them and then stops there; it does not carry on past.

scenarios.text: With the other-mods percent set to 50 in Mod Settings, another mod's incendiary charge of the vanilla Flame damage type goes off beside a colonist and throws him about a quarter of what a frag grenade would.
scenarios.expect: reject: a modded damage type our patch already tunes, such as the fire type, keeps that tuning (about half), and the other-mods percent is never stacked on it.

scenarios.text: A toxic gas shell bursts beside a group of raiders; the burst pushes each of them a cell or two outward as the green cloud spreads, which the player reads as the blast's force.
scenarios.expect: reject: toxic gas bursts, like EMP, smoke, stun and extinguish, throw nothing.

scenarios.text: The player switches 'fire at half' off. In the next raid an incendiary shell lands one cell from a colonist; flames spread around her, and she stays where she stands.
scenarios.expect: accept: with fire at half off, fire and incendiary blasts throw nothing, as shipped.

scenarios.text: A raider stands on a covered pit trap when a frag grenade lands two cells away, with the cover inside its radius. Dirt sprays across the cover and the raider is staggered, but the cover holds and he stays standing on it.
scenarios.expect: reject: a damaging blast that reaches a pit cover within its radius breaks it even when it lands beside the cover, and the pawn on it falls in.

scenarios.text: A gas clump bursts one cell from a raider and shoves him one cell onto a covered pit trap. The cover cracks under the jolt and he drops into the pit.
scenarios.expect: reject: a pawn that a gas burst shoves onto a cover stands on it, and the cover stays whole.

scenarios.text: A colonist stands one cell from an open pit when a burning gas clump next to her bursts, shoves her one cell sideways onto the open pit cell, and she falls to the pit floor unhurt by the burst.
scenarios.expect: accept: a gas clump's one-cell shove is not a throw but is force, and a pawn shoved onto an open pit cell falls in.

scenarios.text: During a six-shell mortar barrage into a full stockpile followed by a 40-cell gas chain, the frame probe reads a 99th-percentile frame of 41 ms inside the 0.9-8.25 s window, with one single 130 ms stall in the window, reported beside it.
scenarios.expect: accept: the bar is the 99th-percentile frame at most 50 ms, and a single random stall is reported, not judged.
